source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A true colour (TCI, 10 m), Earth Search STAC / AWS Open Data

period.summary: Flood from the Khowai embankment breach of 9 July 2026; the embankment breached again on 23 August and the area flooded a third time on 28 August. No end date in the sources used.

sources.says: Breach at Kaliganj, Laskarpur union, on the night of 9 July; floodwaters have begun to recede (no date given).
Breaches on 9 July and 23 August, third flooding on 28 August; repairs delayed by daily rain.

searched: All 79 Sentinel-2 L2A scenes covering the study area, 1 June – 10 November 2026
rule: A stage gets an image only when its capture date and what it shows support the stage. No image is used twice and no frame is made between captures.

frame.heading: Before the flood
frame.sentence: Dry season: the Khowai runs in a narrow channel around the town.
frame.why: Clear dry-season image three months before the breach; June scenes are 80–100 % cloud.
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a

stages.title: Flood begins
stages.missing: Every Sentinel-2 image from 4 July to 19 August 2026 is 90–100 % cloud over the study area; 24 July shows only small gaps in the cloud.

stages.title: Towards the end of the flood

frame.sentence: The Khowai is wide and brown with muddy water; no flooded fields can be told apart at 10 m.
frame.why: First clear image after the third flooding (28 August). The end of the flood is not confirmed, so the image is labelled with its date.
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a

frame.heading: After the flood
frame.sentence: The Khowai is narrower again and no standing water is visible around the town.
frame.why: Latest fully clear image; the river is visibly narrower than on 14 September (also on 12 and 22 October).
frame.catalog: Earth Search STAC (AWS Open Data), collection sentinel-2-l2a
